messages.author: d67fd9d8fb784297
messages.subject: semPaths() - changing the width of the line
parts:
hello all.
when i use semPaths and set what="std" i get a weighted edges plot which is what i want.

the thing is that the scale of the weight is very transparent in a way that even significant coefficients look very "pale"

is there a way to have the lines on a more "darker" scale?

thank you

messages.author: 0964d4061cf3f269
messages.subject: Re: semPaths() - changing the width of the line
parts:
Hi isomitzi,

use the cut argument within the semPaths function to cut the scaling of edges in width and color saturation. For example set "cut = .01".

Hope this helps!
Philipp
